svg.text: Before You Merge — Serverless AI Reviewer for Breaking API Changes on AWS
Reference architecture (deployed and validated in us-east-1, Nov 2026) · Amazon Bedrock · Amazon Bedrock AgentCore · Amazon Q Developer · Serverless release gate
A · Main developer workflow — submit → analyse → test → deterministic gate → human decision
build · review · troubleshoot — not in runtime path
Orchestrated by Step Functions (6) — each stage writes evidence to S3 / DynamoDB
B · AI & tool boundary detail — inside Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
One official AgentCore service icon exists; sub-features are labelled on it.
• No approve / merge / deploy tool exposed to the agent
• AI output is advisory — it cannot set the verdict
• Failing or missing evidence can never be approved
